sections.title: Hostels
sections.text: Separate blocks for women and men with study lounges on every floor, gyms in each block and a 24-hour health centre on both campuses.

sections.title: Clubs and societies
sections.text: From robotics and debating to classical music and theatre: 86 student-run clubs, each with a budget from the student activity fund.

sections.title: Sports
sections.text: Olympic-size pool, synthetic athletics track, cricket ground and indoor courts in Pune; football turf and indoor courts in Bengaluru.

sections.title: Festivals
sections.text: Spandan, the cultural festival, every February; Varenya Tech Week every September; the design degree show every May.

sections.title: Wellbeing
sections.text: Free, confidential counselling with qualified psychologists; peer mentors for every first-year student.

sections.title: Food
sections.text: Four mess halls with North and South Indian menus, Jain and vegan options, and a food court open till midnight.
